proposal.expected_benefit: This would reduce the risk of adversarial manipulation by ensuring that emergency stop triggers are both authentic and not subject to immediate exploitation.
proposal.problem: The emergency stop mechanism may not be robust enough to prevent adversarial manipulation of the consensus mechanism.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a multi-layered verification process for emergency stop triggers, including cryptographic validation of the triggering signal and a time-delayed confirmation phase to prevent rapid, malicious activation.
proposal.title: Enhance Robustness of Emergency Stop Mechanism
verification_tests: Simulate adversarial attempts to trigger emergency stop with forged signals
Test time-delayed confirmation phase under high-load conditions
